narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the project.
finalText:
**Build passes now.** Two real bugs, not noise.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [src/core/options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `options.retries` renamed to `retryCount`, so `.toFixed` threw | Read both keys |
| [src/net/retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Unset flag is now `undefined`, strict check threw | Treat unset as off |

The rest is deprecation noise. 39 `WARN` lines remain, all from bumped deps.

Next: fix `crypto.createCipher` in `src/legacy/adapter.js`. That one is flagged for removal before v5.
